themes.title: Traditional Kerala Onam
themes.detail: Use vibrant kolam patterns at the entrance and decorate the lawn with pookalam stalls and floral borders.

themes.title: Festive Harvest
themes.detail: Centerpieces featuring coconuts, banana leaves, and mangoes to echo the harvest spirit of Onam.

themes.title: Cultural Fusion
themes.detail: Blend Kerala motifs with Bengaluru street art for a modern, local feel.

decor.title: Pookalam Stalls
decor.detail: Set up small kiosks where guests can create and display their own pookalam designs.

decor.title: Kolam Pathways
decor.detail: Draw intricate kolam patterns on the ground leading to the stage using chalk and flower petals.

decor.title: Floral Archways
decor.detail: Hang flower garlands and mango branches to create welcoming arches at entry points.

food.title: Kerala Feast
food.detail: Offer traditional dishes like Puttu, Kadala Curry, and Avial served in banana leaf platters.

food.title: Onam Biryani
food.detail: Serve fragrant, vegetable biryani with raita and a side of spicy pickle.

food.title: Sweet Treats
food.detail: Set up a dessert table with Payasam, Kheer, and traditional sweet snacks.

entertainment.title: Local Folk Performers
entertainment.detail: Invite local folk groups to perform Kathakali-inspired dances and traditional music.

entertainment.title: Pookalam Competition
entertainment.detail: Organise a live pookalam contest with categories for best design, most vibrant, and most creative.

entertainment.title: Interactive Games
entertainment.detail: Include traditional games like Tug of War and Kabaddi with Kerala twists.

themes.title: Vibrant Punjab Fest
themes.detail: A colourful palette of bright reds, oranges, and golds with traditional Punjabi motifs, creating an energetic atmosphere.

themes.title: Lively Street‑Festival
themes.detail: Inspired by Punjabi street fairs, featuring vibrant stalls, lanterns, and playful decor that echo a bustling celebration.

themes.title: Glamorous Fusion
themes.detail: Combine traditional Punjabi elements with a modern twist, using sparkling lights and contemporary patterns.

decor.title: Colorful Bandhanas
decor.detail: Adorn the venue with vibrant bandhanas (tied fabric strings) in bright hues that reflect Punjabi vibrancy.

decor.title: Floral Lanterns
decor.detail: Hang lanterns with mixed flowers in bright colors, adding a festive glow to the setting.

decor.title: Bunting Banners
decor.detail: Create large, colourful banners with Punjabi motifs to frame entryways and seating areas.

food.title: Punjabi Feast
food.detail: Include butter chicken, paneer tikka, and a variety of tandoori dishes served with butter naan and rice.

food.title: Street‑Food Stalls
food.detail: Set up small stalls offering samosas, pakoras, and jalebi to capture the lively street‑food vibe.

food.title: Dessert Carousel
food.detail: A carousel of sweet treats—gulab jamun, kulfi, and chocolate laddoo—to keep guests excited.

entertainment.title: Dhol Band
entertainment.detail: A lively dhol ensemble for the baraat, ensuring a big, loud, and colourful entrance.

entertainment.title: DJ Mix
entertainment.detail: Blend Punjabi beats with contemporary music for continuous dancing throughout the event.

entertainment.title: Fireworks Finale
entertainment.detail: End the night with a spectacular fireworks display that lights up the Bengaluru sky.

themes.title: Royal Princess Palace
themes.detail: Transform the living room into a castle with pink and purple draped fabric, handmade banners, and a cardboard throne for the birthday girl.

themes.title: Enchanted Garden
themes.detail: Use flower garlands in pastel pinks and purples, hanging paper lanterns, and a DIY flower arch made from foam and ribbons.

themes.title: Fairy Tale Carousel
themes.detail: Create a carousel backdrop with printed cardboard horses, tie them with pink streamers, and add glittery paper stars.

decor.title: DIY Balloon Arch
decor.detail: Create a balloon arch in pink and purple using inexpensive balloons tied to a cardboard frame.

decor.title: Paper Flower Bunting
decor.detail: Handmade paper flowers in varying shades of pink and purple tied together to make bunting across the party area.

decor.title: Colorful Table Runners
decor.detail: Make table runners from printed fabric or colored paper, cut into strips and tied with ribbon.

food.title: Mini Sandwich Platter
food.detail: Serve bite‑size sandwiches with cucumber, cheese and lettuce, cut into small shapes for kids.

food.title: Fruit Skewers
food.detail: Thread pink strawberries, grapes, and blueberries on skewers, sprinkle with a little powdered sugar.

food.title: Homemade Cupcakes
food.detail: Bake cupcakes, frost them in pastel pink, top with a small pink topper, and give each child a cupcake as a treat.

entertainment.title: Princess Storytime
entertainment.detail: Read a short princess story, encouraging kids to act out scenes.

entertainment.title: DIY Crown Craft
entertainment.detail: Provide plain cardboard crowns, stickers, and colored paper for kids to decorate their own princess crowns.

entertainment.title: Color‑Matching Game
entertainment.detail: Play a quick game where children match colored cards of pink and purple, winning a small prize.

themes.title: Eid Milán Minimalist
themes.detail: Use muted earth tones and simple geometric patterns with a focus on clean lines and natural textures.

themes.title: Elegant Lantern Glow
themes.detail: Incorporate soft, warm lantern lighting to create an inviting atmosphere while keeping décor understated.

themes.title: Natural Heritage
themes.detail: Celebrate Bengaluru’s green heritage with potted plants and bamboo accents for a calm, elegant vibe.

decor.title: DIY Lantern Arch
decor.detail: Create an arch of wooden lanterns at the entrance using local wood and simple LED strips.

decor.title: Green Hanging Planters
decor.detail: Hang terracotta pots with succulents or herbs from pergolas for a fresh, low‑cost touch.

decor.title: Paper Flower Accents
decor.detail: Use handcrafted paper flowers in modest sizes as table centerpieces and wall decor.

food.title: Halal Buffet Stations
food.detail: Set up separate buffet stalls with biryani, grilled kebabs, and vegetarian curries, all certified halal.

food.title: Bengaluru‑Inspired Snacks
food.detail: Offer local snacks like samosas and pakoras, prepared in halal kitchens with minimal spices.

food.title: Dessert Corner
food.detail: Feature a simple dessert station with halftone‑colored cupcakes, fruit chaat, and halāl‑approved sweets.

entertainment.title: Live Acoustic Ensemble
entertainment.detail: Invite a local folk band to play soft, traditional tunes that complement the event’s calm tone.

entertainment.title: Cultural Poetry Readings
entertainment.detail: Arrange short readings of Urdu or Hindi poetry to enrich the community feel.

entertainment.title: Interactive Games
entertainment.detail: Include simple outdoor games like ring toss and sack races for all ages.
